issues.description: Forward QFT method name mismatch: the template repository defines a method named _qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) (leading underscore) while the solution repository implements a public method named qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit). The problem statement's Exercise 6.1 and test identifier (test_ex1_qft_circuit) refer to implementing the QFT circuit (public API). This naming difference can cause students who implement the template stub to end up with a differently named method than the solution/tests expect, causing automated tests or example usages to fail or confuse students about which method to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API consistent across artifacts. Rename the template method _qft_circuit to qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) so the method name matches the solution and the exercise/test expectation. Keep qft_circuit_inverse unchanged and ensure it calls qft_circuit. Alternatively, if the intent is to keep the underscore, update tests and the solution to call/expect _qft_circuit, but the simpler fix is to expose qft_circuit in the template.
